note: Family campground at 251 Hodgson Rd near Darlington (Beaver Co), close to the PA Turnpike and the Ohio line. Full-hookup RV sites with 20/30/50-amp metered electric, back-in and pull-through, for rigs to 45 ft, plus water/electric and pop-up sites and primitive tent sites; nightly, weekly, monthly and seasonal stays. Hot showers, flush toilets, saltwater pool, catch-and-release fishing pond (RV sites not confirmed pond-front), Wi-Fi near the office. Open April 15 - October 15. RV sites $50 a night plus metered electric; book online through Campspot or by phone. RV Life 4★, price $$ (2/4). --Claude
summary: Confirmed fees ($50 a night + metered electric), 50-amp/water/sewer.
